stepTitle: Capture Doom Exe Clean Launch Feasibility
description: Captures the feasibility verdict for cleanly launching doom/DOOM.EXE on a modern 64-bit Windows host. Verdict is derived from local byte-level header inspection: DOOM.EXE is a valid 32-bit Windows PE32 executable (IMAGE_FILE_MACHINE_I386, optional header magic 0x10B) that launches under the Win64 NT loader through the WOW64 32-bit subsystem without DOS emulation, satisfying the host capability requirements for Win32 process creation.
verdictRationale: doom/DOOM.EXE begins with the MZ signature 0x4D 0x5A, the DWORD at file offset 0x3C points to a valid in-file PE header at offset 0x1AC carrying the `PE\0\0` signature, the machine type is IMAGE_FILE_MACHINE_I386 (0x14C), and the optional-header magic is PE32 (0x10B). The Win64 NT loader resolves 32-bit PE32 i386 binaries through the WOW64 subsystem, so DOOM.EXE can be launched as a Windows process on this host without DOS emulation.
